plan.title: Durable Proactive On-Call Agent Mesh, High-Frequency Triage, and Pi-Style Streaming UI
plan.goal: Establish full architectural parity with Pi Durable, TypeSafe Jev, and the IndyDevDan Pi UI interface by delivering a sub-second System 1 stream triage engine, a crash-resilient durable agent runtime with Effect Sandwich reconciliation, an autonomous on-call incident response daemon, and a real-time multi-agent streaming canvas with human-in-the-loop interaction.
success_criteria: System 1 triage evaluates live telemetry in <200ms with persistent journald cursors and calibrated probabilities
Agent execution implements the Effect Sandwich pattern with explicit outcome reconciliation surviving simulated mid-step crashes
Autonomous on-call daemon wakes on high-confidence incidents, isolates in worktree, generates Tier-0 validated fixes, and stages PRs
Web Dashboard and Herdr presentation expose real-time multi-agent hierarchy tree, live token/tool streaming window, and operator guidance input
Service coverage contract satisfied with dedicated aq-qa checks 0.10.66, 0.10.67, & 0.10.68, live dashboard panels, and zero security regressions
